community-group-buying-warehousing-logistics Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release providing a comprehensive skill pack for warehousing and logistics in community group-buying.
- Covers fulfillment chain from warehouse to group leader, including delivery modes, system design, timeliness management, cost control, and supporting tools.
- Includes practical SOPs, industry benchmarks, cost calculators, and exception handling templates.
- Designed for platform operations managers and logistics professionals.
